entries: {@bold Components:} Masterwork weapon that doesn't have the Finesse, Foregrip, Light, Thrown, or Versatile properties

This weapon gains the Two-Handed property and its damage die increases by one step. Additionally, if it is a ranged weapon, its normal range increases by 50 feet and its long range increases accordingly.

name: Unerring Strike
entries: When you cast the {@spell true strike} cantrip, you can concentrate on it for a number of rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier. You gain advantage on the first attack roll you make against the target on each of your turns while maintaining concentration on {@spell true strike}.

name: Vampiric
entries: {@bold Components:} Masterwork exotic weapon
This weapon deals an extra {@dice 1d4} necrotic damage on a hit. When you hit a hostile creature with this weapon, you regain hit points equal to the extra necrotic damage dealt by this property.

name: Venom
entries: {@bold Components:} Masterwork exotic weapon
This weapon deals an extra {@dice 1d8} poison damage on a hit.

name: Venom Bomb
entries: By mixing a few drops of a fast-acting toxin into your bomb's explosive components, you can change it into a venom bomb. A venom bomb deals poison damage instead of fire damage, has {@dice d8} damage dice, and requires a Constitution saving throw instead of a Dexterity save. Additionally, the target, as well as each creature within the blast radius that fails its saving throw, have disadvantage on the next Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn

name: Venom Sac
entries: {@b Donor:} Any creature which can poison a creature or deal poison damage with an attack not provided by a weapon
{@b Slot:} Internal

You have installed a gland which secretes poison from your body. As a bonus action, you can coat a natural weapon, if you have one, or a weapon you are holding in basic poison. The save DC for the poison equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus.
Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Versatile
entries: {@bold Components:} Masterwork melee weapon that doesn't have the Light or Two-Handed properties
This weapon gains the Versatile property. While being wielded in two hands, its damage die increases by one step.

name: Voice Box
entries: {@b Donor:} Any creature with the Mimicry trait
{@b Slot:} Head

You have augmented your own vocal folds with those of a creature that can mimic sounds. You can mimic any sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check, contested by your Charisma (Deception) check.

name: Vorpal
entries: {@bold Components:} Masterwork exotic weapon that deals slashing damage

When you make an attack against a creature with this weapon and score a critical hit, that target takes an extra {@dice 4d8} slashing damage. Then roll another {@dice d20}. If you roll a 20 on the second roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn't have or need a head, has legendary actions, or the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage from the hit.

name: War Hex
entries: When you cast a hex that targets a single creature, you can use your bonus action to cast a cantrip targeting the same creature.

name: Ward
entries: As an action, choose one creature you can see other than yourself within 60 feet of you. Each time the creature takes damage before the end of your next turn, the damage it takes is reduced by 3.

name: Warding
entries: {@bold Components:} Masterwork suit of exotic medium armor
This suit of armor generates a field of force, protecting its wearer from harm. As a bonus action on your turn, you can gain temporary hit points equal to half your craftsman level.

name: Webspinner Apparatus
entries: {@b Donor:} Any creature with a Web action
{@b Slot:} Internal

You have installed spinnerets from a spiderlike creature into your body, allowing you to produce webs. You can cast the spell {@spell web} without using spell slots or spell components (DC equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus).
Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Winged
entries: {@bold Components:} Masterwork suit of exotic light armor

This armor has a set of wings that you can extend from it or fold back into it as a bonus action. While wearing this armor with the wings extended, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

name: Wisp of Shadow
entries: While wearing your pact cloak, you do not take any damage from falling.

name: Abominable Familiar
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can shape-shift your familiar into an abominable monster. This transformation lasts for 1 hour or until your {@status Concentration|XPHB} ends. Your familiar uses the {@creature Abominable Familiar|ValdaSpire24} stat block and retains none of the benefits of the {@classFeature Familiar|Witch|ValdaSpire24|2|ValdaSpire24|Familiar feature}, except for Spell Channeling and Synchronized Turns. On its turn, the familiar can use Multiattack.
Once you use this Grand Hex, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5+ spell slot (no action required).

name: Acid Bomb
entries: By mixing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a few drops of ardenflotic acid, a highly corrosive chemical, you can change it into an Acid Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Acid damage instead of Fire damage and all of its damage dice are d8s. A target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it has a -3 penalty to its AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Adventurer
entries: You picked up your magic informally by traveling with a dozen different mages over the years. You learn the {@spell Mage Hand|XPHB} and {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Perception|XPHB} skill.

name: Alchemy of Alteration
entries: Your research has revealed how to warp the body and mind. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Batch Brewing
entries: The number of potions you can have at one time increases by 2.

entries.name: Potion Ingredients
entries: You gain 4 additional {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1} which you can only use to brew potions.

entries.name: Expanded Potions
entries: You can brew the following potions at the Alchemist levels given. If a potion forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your Alchemist save DC.

name: Alchemy of Poison
entries: Your research has taught you how to concoct poisonous compounds. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Batch Brewing
entries: The number of potions you can have at one time increases by 2.

entries.name: Poisoner's Kit
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@item Poisoner's Kit|XPHB}.

entries.name: Potent Poison
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Poison damage, it ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage.

entries.name: Poison Crafting
entries: You can brew the following poisons at the Alchemist levels given. If a poison forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your Alchemist save DC. These poisons count toward the number of potions you have brewed at one time, and are included in the 5th Edition rules.

name: Alchemy of Restoration
entries: Your research has unveiled a plethora of medicines and remedies. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Batch Brewing
entries: The number of potions you can have at one time increases by 2.

entries.name: Double Dose
entries: Whenever you brew a {@item Potion of Healing|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Greater Healing|XDMG}, or {@item Potion of Superior Healing|XDMG}, the potion has two uses. Drinking the potion expends one use.

entries.name: Expanded Potions
entries: You can brew the following potions at the Alchemist levels given.

name: Arcane Event
entries: An influx of insidious magic left an imprint on you. You learn the {@spell Acid Splash|XPHB} and {@spell Message|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Insight|XPHB} skill.

name: Arcane Studies
entries: Dabbling in arcana has granted you limited magic. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Two Cantrips
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this Discovery's spells.

entries.name: Level 1 and 2 Spells
entries: Choose a level 1 spell and a level 2 spell from the Wizard spell list. You always have these spells prepared. You can cast each once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of a spell by taking the {@action Magic|XPHB} action and expending a number of {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1} equal to the level of the spell. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

entries.name: Spell Change
entries: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this Discovery with a different spell of the same level from the Wizard spell list.

name: Avenger
entries: You are on a mission to exact vengeance. You gain a bonus to {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

Additionally, choose up to five specific creatures that you wish to seek revenge against. You must know these creatures' names or must otherwise have enough information to identify them. Your attacks with weapons and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} against the chosen creatures deal an extra {@damage 1d8} damage on a hit. The damage is the same type dealt by the weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

name: Battle Edge
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using Strength or Dexterity, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to improve the damage roll. Add the Battle Die and your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever you don't already add, minimum of 1) to the attack's damage roll.

name: Bear Hug
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to grapple the target. Roll the Battle Die. The target takes extra Bludgeoning damage equal to the roll of the Battle Die, and the target subtracts the Battle Die from its saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

name: Bishop's Maneuver
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend spell slot to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. The number of feet you can teleport equals 15 feet times the level of the spell slot expended.

name: Blackjack
entries: When you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and fail, you can roll another {@dice d20} and add it to the test, potentially causing it to succeed. If the sum of the d20s exceeds 21, the test automatically fails.
Once you use this trick, you can't do so again until you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} or finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Blasting Cantrip
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you deal Force damage to a creature with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=force}, you can push the creature up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

name: Blinding Attack
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend two Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to blind the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the condition on itself on a success.

name: Blinding Cantrip
entries: When you cast the {@spell Light|XPHB} cantrip on an object you are holding, you can direct a flare at a creature you can see within 10 feet of yourself, which must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. A creature that fails its save against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

name: Blitz
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to maneuver one of your {@variantrule Ally|XPHB|Allies}. Add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll. Choose an {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you. That {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

name: Bludgeon
entries: You can treat this weapon as a Melee weapon with {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse}. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, it deals Bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, or {@dice 1d8} plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier if the weapon is wielded in two hands.

name: Bolster
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die to motivate an ally within 60 feet of yourself. The next time your ally makes an attack before the start of your next turn, it adds the Battle Die to the attack and damage roll.

name: Born Leader
entries: When you fail a Wisdom or Charisma check, you can expend one Battle Die to add it to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.

name: Bramble Bomb
entries: By adding soil and a potent fertilizer to your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents, you can change it into a Bramble Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals no damage. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, each creature within the explosion makes a Strength saving throw, instead of Dexterity. The area of the explosion is filled with thorny brambles and is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. A target on the ground hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it is entangled in the brambles and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 and can't increase. An entangled creature can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your Alchemist save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the brambles and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is no longer 0. The brambles shrivel and die after 1 minute.

name: Bull Rush
entries: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack roll, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to perform a Bull Rush. The target takes extra Bludgeoning damage equal to the roll of the Battle Die, and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Burned
entries: Your body has been scorched by arcane flames, leaving you with striking scars and embers burning under your skin. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage, and you know the {@spell Produce Flame|XPHB} cantrip, which doesn't count against your number of cantrips known.

name: Capture
entries: You gain the following formation:

entries.name: Capture
entries: You can use this formation when you and three or more {@variantrule Ally|XPHB|Allies} that don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition are adjacent to an enemy and surround it. You can determine this by placing an imaginary cube around the enemy. If you and your {@variantrule Ally|XPHB|Allies} are adjacent to each side of the cube, the creature is surrounded.

When you activate this formation, the enemy must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or be enveloped by chains of magical force and have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The {@condition Stunned|XPHB} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself and this formation on a success.
Once you use this trick, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Castle
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can choose a willing Small or Medium creature you can see within 120 feet of you. You both teleport, swapping places.
Once you use this trick, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Cauldron
entries: You can brew potions in a bubbling cauldron using ingredients scavenged from nature.

entries.name: Alchemy Points
entries: You have a pool of Alchemy Points equal to your Witch level which you use to brew potions. You regain all expended Alchemy Points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Brewing Potions
entries: You can spend 10 minutes and expend any number of Alchemy Points to brew potions, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}. Potion options are detailed on the Cauldron Potions table. You can have a total number of potions at one time up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). These potions retain potency until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, after which they become inert.

When you brew potions, you can also distill potions you have already brewed, destroying them and recovering the Alchemy Points expended to brew them, up to a maximum of your Witch level. You can expend these Alchemy Points immediately to brew new potions.

name: Challenge
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to goad the target into attacking you. Add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll. Until the start of your next turn, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures other than you while you are within 5 feet of the target.

name: Check
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to threaten the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Chips are Down
entries: When you expend one or more Chips of Fate to bet and lose at least one bet, you regain one expended Chip of Fate.

name: Circus Performer
entries: You learned a few simple tricks to participate in a sideshow or circus act. You learn the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} and {@spell Starry Wisp|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB} skill.

name: Cleave
entries: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Combat Studies
entries: Your research extends into the strategy and tactics of warfare. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Martial Training
entries: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and {@item Shield|XPHB|Shields}.

entries.name: Breacher
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make an attack with a weapon that isn't a {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} and doesn't have {@itemProperty H|XPHB|Heavy}.

entries.name: Fire Brand
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon, you can expend 1 {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1||Reagent} to deal an extra {@damage 1d10} Fire damage to the target.

name: Commander's Steed
entries: You can cast {@spell Find Steed|XPHB} without expending a spell slot and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you cast the spell using this trick, its spell slot level is your Warmage level divided by four, rounded up.

name: Concussion Bomb
entries: By mixing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a few drops of air elemental essence, you can change it into a Concussion Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Thunder damage instead of Fire damage. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, each creature within the explosion makes a Constitution saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A Huge or smaller target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} is pushed 10 feet away from you. A Huge or smaller creature that fails its saving throw against this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it is pushed 10 feet away from you or the center of the explosion, respectively.

name: Contingent Cantrip
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can spend 10 minutes performing a ritual to create a Contingent {@variantrule Cantrip|XPHB}. Cast a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (VSS'24)} that has a casting time of an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and doesn't deal damage. The cantrip doesn't take effect immediately, but instead it takes effect the next time you speak a specified command word (no action required). When you perform this ritual, choose whether the cantrip targets you, the nearest {@variantrule Ally|XPHB}, or the nearest {@variantrule Enemy|XPHB}. You can't use Warmage tricks on the cantrip when it comes into effect. You can only have one Contingent {@variantrule Cantrip|XPHB} at a time. If you perform this ritual again, the previous Contingent {@variantrule Cantrip|XPHB} ends.

name: Corrosive Cantrip
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you deal Acid damage to a creature with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=acid}, you can cause the acid to erode the target's defenses. The next time a creature makes an attack roll against the target before the start of your next turn, the target takes a penalty to its AC equal to half your Warmage level (up to a maximum of -5) for that attack.

name: Coup de Grâce
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend two Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to execute the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. If you reduce the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you regain one expended Battle Die.

name: Coven
entries: You can induct others into your insidious coven. Forming a Coven. By performing a special ritual over the course of 8 hours, which can be done during a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can intermingle your cursed magic with a willing creature which then enters into your coven. Your coven can have up to three members, including yourself.

entries.name: Coven Range
entries: A member of your coven only gains access to this feature's benefits if it is within 30 feet of another coven member.

entries.name: Prepared Coven Spells
entries: Coven members temporarily prepare the spells of the Coven Spells table, which don't count against the number of spells they can prepare. These spells must be a level for which a coven member has spell slots. A coven member that lacks the Spellcasting and Pact Magic features only prepares level 1 spells.

entries.name: Shared Spell Slots
entries: Coven members gain access to a shared pool of five spell slots—one of each level, from 1 to 5—which they can use to cast spells as normal. Expended spell slots are regained when all members of the coven finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: A coven member uses its own spellcasting ability for Coven Spells. A coven member that lacks the Spellcasting and Pact Magic features chooses Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for its spellcasting ability when it enters the coven.

entries.name: Male and Female Witches
entries: Witches are commonly considered to be only female, but in reality, Witches can be any gender. This misconception stems from the fact that masculine Witches are often called "Hexers" or incorrectly deemed Warlocks by common folk.

name: Crush

prerequisite.other: {@filter Bludgeoning Damage [Craftsman Only]|items|source=|type=melee weapon;ranged weapon|weapon damage type=b}

entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has a −3 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the AC penalty doesn't exceed −3.

name: Cryo Bomb
entries: By replacing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a sliver of ice-nine, you can change it into a Cryo Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Cold damage instead of Fire damage and all of its damage dice are d8s. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, each creature within the explosion makes a Constitution saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it has a -3 penalty to its attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

name: Cursed
entries: You have been cursed by an item that you must always keep at your side. You have one of the following magic items of your choice: {@item Cloak of Elvenkind|XDMG}, {@item Cloak of Protection|XDMG}, {@item Gloves of Swimming and Climbing|XDMG}, {@item Helm of Telepathy|XDMG}, {@item Ring of Jumping|XDMG}, or {@item Stone of Good Luck|XDMG}. You might have a different item of the GM's choice. If this item is more than 5 feet away from yourself, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

name: Dartmaster
entries: When you cast a cantrip that allows you to make multiple ranged spell attacks, such as {@spell Magic Daggers|ValdaSpire24} or {@spell Force Dart|ValdaSpire24} using the {@optfeature Split Fire|ValdaSpire24} trick, and you miss with one or more attacks, you can reroll all of your misses and must use the new rolls.
Once you use this trick, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Daze
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn.

name: Dig Deep
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die to gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number rolled on the die plus your Constitution modifier.

name: Dodge Roll
entries: You can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move up to 15 feet and reload any Ranged weapon you are holding. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and is unaffected by {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

name: Draining Cantrip
entries: Whenever you deal Necrotic or Poison damage to an enemy with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=necrotic;poison}, you can siphon some of its life force. You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half your Warmage level, which last for 1 minute.

name: Drowned
entries: Water fills your lungs, and yet you live. You can breathe underwater and have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Dual Hex
entries: When you cast a {@filter Hex|spells|level=0|subschool=hex|cast time=action} as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can cast a second Hex or cast the original Hex a second time targeting a different creature as a part of the same action. Both Hexes must have a casting time of an action. When you {@classFeature Cackle|Witch|ValdaSpire24|2}, you extend the duration of both Hexes by 1 round.
Each target affected by your Hexes counts as being the sole target of your Hex for {@classFeature Insidious Spell|Witch|ValdaSpire24|5} and other Witch features.

name: Dying
entries: A terminal, possibly magical, affliction has gripped you. When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} and aren't {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can drop to a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half your maximum and become {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

name: Eagle Eye
entries: Once per turn when you miss with a ranged attack roll, you can expend one Battle Die and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing the attack to hit.

name: Effortless Dodge
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die to take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} or {@action Dodge|XPHB} action. You can't use this maneuver while wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

name: Encryptogram
entries: Your knowledge of ciphers has improved your magically clandestine communications. When you cast the {@spell Cryptogram|ValdaSpire24} cantrip, its limit is 20 characters, instead of 8, and you can choose to magically encrypt the message such that only the specified recipient can read it.

name: Explode

prerequisite.other: {@filter Fire Damage, Ranged Weapon [Craftsman Only]|items|weapon damage type=f}

entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can replace one of your ranged attacks with an explosion from this weapon's projectile. This explosion is a 5-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within the weapon's normal range. Each creature within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. You can create this explosion only once per turn.

name: Explosive Cantrip
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you deal Fire damage to a creature with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=fire}, you can create an explosion in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the target. Each creature other than the target and yourself within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking half the Fire damage rolled on a failed save, or no damage on a successful one.

name: Extended Range
entries: When you cast a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (VSS'24)} that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can double its range. You can also double the length of {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Lines}, the size of {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cones} and {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cubes}, and the radii of {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinders}, {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanations}, and {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Spheres} created by your Warmage cantrips.

name: Faction Agent
entries: You are secretly a member of an organization, such as a Thieves' Guild or a secret society. You gain proficiency and {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} with any skill of your choice.
Additionally, you gain proficiency in one tool and learn one language of your choice.

name: False Identity
entries: You magically conceal your true appearance. You can cast {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell in this way, you can only change your appearance to match a pre-established second identity. Whenever you gain a Vagabond level, you can change how this second identity looks when you cast the spell in this way.

Additionally, when you choose this secret, choose one falsehood about yourself can recite it perfectly. This falsehood can be a single lie or an entire false history. You never need to make a {@skill Deception|XPHB} check for this falsehood.

name: Fear Bomb
entries: By mixing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with concentrated adrenaline, you can change it into a Fear Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Psychic damage instead of Fire damage and all of its damage dice are d6s. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, each creature within the explosion makes a Wisdom saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

name: Feral
entries: Through your curse, you have forgotten the manners and customs of civilization. You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|XPHB} skill. Additionally, while you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 13 plus your Dexterity modifier.

name: Field Medic
entries: You learn the {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB} cantrip. You can cast this cantrip as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Additionally, when you cast it on a creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the target regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Warmage level, which last for 1 minute.
Once a creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from this trick, it can't do so again until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Finisher
entries: If you hit a creature that is Bloodied with this weapon and deal damage, you can deal an extra 1d8 damage to the target. The damage is the same type as the damage dealt by the weapon and you can only deal this extra damage once per turn.

name: Flash of Brilliance
entries: When you fail an Intelligence or Wisdom check, you can expend one Battle Die to add it to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.

name: Bolstering Spell
entries: When you cast a spell with a duration other than Instantaneous targeting an ally, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and expend one Battle Die to give that ally {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. The number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equals one roll of the Battle Die plus your Intelligence modifier. These {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} vanish when the spell ends.

name: Potent Spell
entries: When you deal damage with a spell, you can expend a Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and add it to one damage roll of the spell.

name: Staggering Spell
entries: When a creature fails a saving throw against a spell that you cast, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to daze the target. Until the start of your next turn, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved and it subtracts the Battle Die from the next attack roll it makes.

name: Unbreakable Concentration
entries: When you fail a saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend a Battle Die and add it to the roll, potentially turning it into a success.

name: Flexible Range
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your ranged attack rolls with Warmage cantrips. Additionally, when you cast a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (VSS'24)} that requires a melee spell attack, you can increase its range to 10 feet.

name: Flourish
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend three Battle Dice to perform a graceful flourish. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. Choose two of the following effects.

items: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} before the start of your next turn.
If the target can make multiple attacks on its turn, it makes one fewer attack than normal, to a minimum of one. You choose which attack is interrupted.
The target can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} until the start of its next turn. If it has Legendary Actions, it loses one use until the start of its next turn.
The target drops one object of your choice that it's holding, with the object landing in a space you choose up to 15 feet away from the target.

name: Flurry

prerequisite.other: {@filter Ammunition, Finesse, Light, or Versatile Property [Craftsman Only]|items|source=|type=|property=light;versatile;finesse;ammunition}

entries: When you make an attack with this weapon, you can choose to make two attacks instead. These attacks are always made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, regardless of circumstance. You can't replace these attacks. If this weapon has the {@itemProperty AF|XDMG|Ammunition} property, these attacks use twice the normal amount of ammunition. This property is often called Automatic when added to Ranged weapons.

name: Fold
entries: You have learned to graciously accept defeat using your Deck of Fate. As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you are hit by an attack, you can play your entire hand to cast {@spell Shield|XPHB} without expending a spell slot.
Once you use this trick, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Follow-Through

prerequisite.other: {@filter Melee Weapon, Heavy Property [Craftsman Only]|items|source=|type=melee weapon|property=heavy}

entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action and hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can forgo a later attack with the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on this turn to perform a heavier swing. You deal {@damage 2d12} extra damage to that creature of the same type dealt by the weapon. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

name: Force Aegis
entries: When you cast the {@spell Force Buckler|ValdaSpire24} cantrip, you can {@condition Concentration|XPHB|Concentrate} on it for up to 1 minute. The spell doesn't end early if you are hit by an attack.

name: Force Breastplate
entries: While you have all of your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage.

name: Forceful Personality
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your maximum for this score increases to 22.

name: Fugitive
entries: You are being hunted. You might be fleeing the authorities, a wayward assassin, or a supernatural force. Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet. Additionally, once per turn, you can give a creature {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} it makes against you.

name: Fundamental Alchemy
entries: Your research has revealed the finer points of brewing basic alchemical substances. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quadruple Flasks
entries: When you brew potions, you can brew a batch of four vials of {@item Acid|XPHB}, {@item Alchemist's Fire|XPHB}, {@item Holy Water|XPHB}, or {@item Oil|XPHB} for 1 {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1||Reagent}. Each batch counts as one potion for the number of potions you can have at once. These batches can be all of one substance or a mix of them.
These substances use your Alchemist save DC and retain potency until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, after which they become inert.

entries.name: Quick Flask
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action with a {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to throw a flask of {@item Alchemist's Fire|XPHB}, {@item Holy Water|XPHB}, {@item Oil|XPHB}, or {@item Acid|XPHB}, or to use an Oil flask to douse a space.

entries.name: Potent Flasks
entries: {@item Acid|XPHB}, {@item Alchemist's Fire|XPHB}, and {@item Holy Water|XPHB} that you brew deal an additional die of damage. {@item Alchemist's Fire|XPHB} also deals this extra die of damage to burning creatures. {@hazard Burning|XPHB} {@item Oil|XPHB} adds your Intelligence modifier to the extra Fire damage it deals.

name: Gambit
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to give your {@variantrule Ally|XPHB|Allies} an opening. Add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll. The next creature other than yourself to make an attack roll against the target adds the Battle Die to the attack roll.

name: Graze
entries: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

name: Guided Explosives
entries: You've learned how to magnify the explosive potential of your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bombs}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Bombs
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls you make using your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bombs}.

entries.name: Aerodynamic Bombs
entries: The normal and long ranges of your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bombs} double.

entries.name: Seeking Charge
entries: When you miss with an attack roll using a {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24}, you can expend a {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1||Reagent} to roll {@dice 1d8} and add the number rolled to the attack roll, potentially causing the attack to hit.

name: Heel-Cutter
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to prevent the target from escaping. Add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

name: Heretic
entries: You hold a forbidden belief or honor a sinister deity. You gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} and {@skill Religion|XPHB} skills. You also learn two cantrips of your choice from the Warlock spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this secret (choose the ability when you select the secret).

name: Hideous
entries: Your appearance is ghastly to behold. You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skill. When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you can choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself to scare. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its turn.

name: Hollow
entries: Your soul has been divorced from your body, trapping you in a limbo between life and death. Whenever you or your familiar reduces an enemy to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Charisma modifier + your Witch level (minimum of 1).

name: Holy Bomb
entries: By adding a few drops of holy water to your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents, you can change it into a Holy Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Radiant damage instead of Fire damage. If a creature that takes damage from the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} is a Fiend or Undead, the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} damage dice against this creature become d12s.

name: Homunculus
entries: Your research has taught you how to create an alchemical homunculus.

entries.name: Creating a Homunculus
entries: By expending 3 {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1} and spending materials worth 10+ GP in a 1-hour long alchemical process, which can be done over a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can create a {@creature Homunculus|XMM}. You can only have one homunculus at a time; if you create another one, your existing one dies.

entries.name: Hit Points
entries: Your homunculus has {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to five times your Alchemist level.

entries.name: Bomb Immunity
entries: Your homunculus automatically succeeds on its saving throws against your Bombs and never takes damage from them.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The homunculus is an ally to you and your allies. It takes its turn immediately before or after your turn each round (your choice). Your homunculus can't attack on its turn, but it can take other actions and {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|Bonus Actions} as normal.

Additionally, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command your homunculus to make one attack with its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. Your homunculus's attack bonus equals your Intelligence modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Elemental Infusion
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 2 {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1} to infuse your homunculus with elemental essence for the next hour. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. While infused, your homunculus has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to this damage and deals {@damage 2d8} extra damage of that type on its damage rolls.

name: Horrific Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to terrify the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Hybrid
entries: While your familiar is within 5 feet of yourself, you can meld with it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, shape-shifting into a magical hybrid and gaining the following benefits. You remain shape-shifted for 1 minute or until you dismiss the transformation (no action required). When your transformation ends, your familiar reappears within 5 feet of yourself or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. Once you use this Grand Hex, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5+ spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Temporary Hit Points
entries: You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your familiar's current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Armor Class
entries: Your AC equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

entries.name: Natural Weapons
entries: You can use your Charisma modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. When you deal damage with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, it deals {@damage 1d10} Force damage instead of the normal damage for your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice instead of once when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.

entries.name: Movement
entries: You can use any {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} your familiar possesses.

name: Icy Cantrip
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you deal Cold damage to a creature with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=cold}, you can numb the target with a frigid blast. The first time the target makes an attack roll before the end of its next turn, subtract half your Warmage level from the attack roll.

name: Impact Bomb
entries: By replacing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a more reactive one, you can change it into an Impact Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Force damage instead of Fire damage and all of its damage dice are d8s. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, each creature within the explosion makes a Strength saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A Huge or smaller target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Incendiary Bomb
entries: By adding a thickening agent to your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents, you can change it into an Incendiary Bomb. All of this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} damage dice are d8s. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, the area of the explosion is filled with flames until the start of your next turn. Whenever a creature enters the area or ends its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take Fire damage equal to the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} damage dice.

name: Infested
entries: You are constantly followed by vermin, like insects and rats, which crawl on your skin and swarm in your wake. Beasts have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attacks against you. Additionally, you can command these pests as your own. At Witch level 2, you can choose the form of a {@creature Swarm of Insects|XPHB} or a {@creature Swarm of Rats|XPHB} for your familiar.

name: Infinite Variation
entries: You have become exceptionally skilled at using the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip to mimic other spells. When you cast {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}, you can attempt to emulate the {@filter effects of another cantrip that doesn't deal damage|spells|source=|level=0|components & miscellaneous=|damage type=!acid;!bludgeoning;!cold;!fire;!force;!lightning;!necrotic;!piercing;!poison;!psychic;!radiant;!slashing;!thunder}, even one that is not on the Warmage spell list. To do so, you must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check, otherwise the spell fails. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for a cantrip cast using this trick, and it counts as a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (VSS'24)} for you.

name: Iron Wall
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die to fortify yourself. The next time you are hit by an attack within the next minute, roll the Battle Die and add the number rolled to your AC against this attack, potentially causing it to miss. This effect ends early if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. You must be wearing Heavy armor to use this maneuver.

name: Jolt

prerequisite.other: {@filter Lightning Damage [Craftsman]|items|source=|type=melee weapon;ranged weapon|weapon damage type=l}

entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, the creature can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} until the start of its next turn.

name: Knack
entries: When you fail an ability check using a skill in which you have proficiency, you can expend one Battle Die to add it to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.

name: Laughing Gas Bomb
entries: By mixing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a drop of jesterate, a highly euphoric chemical, you can change it into a Laughing Gas Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Poison damage instead of Fire damage and all of its damage dice are d8s. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, each creature within the explosion makes a Constitution saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it laughs uncontrollably and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and can't cast spells with a Verbal component until the start of your next turn.

name: Lightning Bomb
entries: By replacing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a charged arcane capacitor, you can change it into a Lightning Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Lightning damage instead of Fire damage. A target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} until the start of its next turn.

name: Lightning Reflexes
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die immediately after regaining your Battle Dice. Add the Battle Die to your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll. You can't use this maneuver if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

name: Loveless
entries: You are cursed to never find true love. You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

name: Mage Hand Knack
entries: Your skill with the {@spell Mage Hand|XPHB} cantrip allows you to use it as an extension of yourself. You can cast the spell as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an action. You can also control the hand as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns, and can use one of the following abilities when you control the hand.

entries.name: Press
entries: The hand pushes against a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of it until the start of your next turn. Choose a direction away from that creature. Every foot of movement in that direction while the hand is pressing against it costs the creature 1 extra foot of movement.

entries.name: Punch
entries: The hand strikes one creature or object within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack for the hand. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} Force damage.

entries.name: Seize
entries: The hand attempts to grapple a Small or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC (it chooses which), or it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition. The escape DC equals your spell save DC. The hand continues grappling the target until the spell ends or you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to control the hand.

name: Magic Moment
entries: When you cast {@spell Moment to Think|ValdaSpire24}, you can choose to also stop time for a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The creature can take one of the actions permitted by the spell during your turn, and you can interact with one another while time is stopped. During this time you can take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action, exchange items, swap locations with a willing creature within 5 feet of you, take the {@action Help|XPHB} action for tasks while time is stopped, attempt to stabilize an {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or have a short conversation without eavesdropping or interruption.

name: Mercenary
entries: You mastered the fundamentals of war magic to engage in battle with similarly armed arcanists. You learn the {@spell Mending|XPHB} and {@spell True Strike|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|XPHB} skill.

name: Minor Shadow Illusion
entries: When you create the image of an object in an unoccupied space using the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip, you can fill it with fibers of shadowstuff, causing it to become partially real. No matter what form the semi-real object takes, it still must be no larger than a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. It has AC 10 and 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it weighs 5 pounds. You can only have one semi-real illusion at a time. While this semi-real object exists, the cantrip requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

The illusion can't replicate a creature, but it can deal damage to a creature within its 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} if the illusion is of an object that can deal damage. A creature that enters the illusion's area or begins its turn there must make an Intelligence saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} damage of a type appropriate to the illusion. This damage can't trigger {@classFeature Warmage Edge|Warmage|ValdaSpire24|1} or any {@filter Warmage tricks|optionalfeatures|source=|feature type=t}. This damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach Warmage level 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Monstrous
entries: You conceal an abominable side that emerges when you're injured. You might be afflicted with lycanthropy, an eldritch curse, or vampirism. You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, its range increases by 60 feet.
Additionally, while you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, your size is Large and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and saving throws.

name: Morale Boost
entries: When an ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself fails a saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend one Battle Die and add it to the roll, potentially turning it into a success.

name: Mounted
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to mount this weapon in a fixed position until the end of your turn. While mounted, this weapon can't be moved and its damage dice increase by one step ({@dice d4} → {@dice d6} → {@dice d8} → {@dice d10} → {@dice d12}, to a maximum of d12s) when the weapon is used to make a ranged attack.

name: Mystical Armor
entries: You can cast {@spell Mage Armor|XPHB} on yourself without expending a spell slot. While under the effects of this spell, you can add your Intelligence modifier, instead of Dexterity, to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

name: Mystical Athlete
entries: When you cast the {@spell Quickstep|ValdaSpire24} cantrip, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 20 feet instead of 10. When you cast the {@spell Springheel|ValdaSpire24} cantrip, the distance of your jumps increases by 20 feet instead of 10 feet. If you know both of these cantrips, you can cast both of them as part of the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

name: Mystical Retort
entries: You learn the {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} cantrip. Additionally, when a creature you can see makes an attack roll against you, you take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cast {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} targeting the attacker. If the creature fails its saving throw, the attacker has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the triggering attack roll, instead of its next attack roll, potentially causing the attack to miss.
Once you cast this cantrip as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Mystical Vision
entries: You can cast the {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot.

name: Mystical Weaponmaster
entries: When you cast {@spell Force Weapon|ValdaSpire24} or {@spell Magic Daggers|ValdaSpire24}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make one additional spell attack with that cantrip.

name: Necrobiology
entries: Your explorations into necromancy have borne scientific fruit. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hemoreagent
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to extract a measure of your own blood and convert it into {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1}. Expend any number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}. You regain a number of expended {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1} equal to half the number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended (round down).

entries.name: Lazarus Bolt
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can drive a bolt into the torso of a creature within 5 feet of you that has died within the last minute and shock it back to life. That creature revives with 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Alchemist level. This Discovery can't return to life a creature that lacks a heart, a creature that has died of old age, or a creature that is missing vital organs. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending 3 {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1} (no action required).

name: Nick
entries: When you make the extra attack of the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property, you can make it as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action instead of as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Nobility
entries: You are of noble descent, now disgraced or disowned. You gain proficiency in the {@skill History|XPHB} and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} skills.
Additionally, you can take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

name: Nudge Fate
entries: You can cast {@spell Cheat|ValdaSpire24} without Verbal or Somatic components.

Additionally, when you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can nudge the {@dice d20}, changing the number to one of the three sides adjacent to the topmost side, potentially causing the roll to succeed. Alternatively, you can reroll the die and must use the new result.
Once you use this trick to nudge a {@dice d20}, you can't use it to do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Numb

prerequisite.other: {@filter Cold Damage [Craftsman Only]|items|source=|type=melee weapon;ranged weapon|weapon damage type=c}

entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, the target can't take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Dodge|XPHB} action or have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Oil Bomb
entries: By mixing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a few drops of a super-surfactant, you can change it into an Oil Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals no damage, but instead causes the target or each creature within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property to become coated with a flammable oil. This oil lasts for 1 minute or until it or another creature takes the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to remove the oil. The next time a creature coated in oil takes Fire damage, you can treat a roll of 1-3 on any damage die as a 4. This destroys the oil on the creature.

name: Opening Move
entries: During the first round of combat, the first spell attack you make has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. You can't use this trick if you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll.

name: Paint Bomb
entries: You can replace your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} contents with vibrant, magical pigment, changing it into a Paint Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals no damage but instead splatters paint within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property. A target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it is coated in paint until the start of your next turn. A coated creature can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition and attacks against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

name: Parry
entries: When you hit a creature with this weapon and you aren't wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, you gain a +2 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} until the start of your next turn. You can gain this bonus only once per turn.

name: Phantom Hookshot
entries: You can cast the {@spell Phantom Grapnel|ValdaSpire24} cantrip as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. If you do so, its range is reduced to 15 feet. When you cast the spell as an action, the target is pulled an additional 10 feet toward you by the spell.

name: Poison Apple
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can produce a magical apple out of thin air. You determine the apple's appearance, such as a ruby-red color or a crystalline skin. The apple shrivels and becomes nonmagical if it isn't eaten within 24 hours. Once you produce an apple, you can't produce another one until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Eating the Apple
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to eat the apple, granting the following benefits.

items: {@b Hit Points.} You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Witch level plus your Charisma modifier.
{@b Regain a Spell Slot.} You regain an expended spell slot of level 5 or lower.

{@b End Condition.} You can remove one of the following conditions from yourself: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} (if the apple is fed to you as an action), or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

entries.name: Another Creature Eating the Apple
entries: If a creature other than yourself eats the apple, it doesn't gain any benefits. Instead, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} or suffer the following effects.

items: {@b Poisoned.}The creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 24 hours.

{@b Hit Point Loss.} At the end of each hour while the creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, it takes {@damage 4d8} Necrotic damage and its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}. If this reduction causes the creature to drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the creature instead drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, falling into a catatonic sleep for 1 year. A {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell or similar magic can awaken this creature early.

name: Possessed
entries: Your soul is occupied by a foreign spirit that whispers magical secrets to you and sometimes tries to wrest away your consciousness. You can prepare an extra Witch spell. You can prepare another extra Witch spell when you reach Witch levels 3 (2 spells) and 5 (3 spells).

name: Possession
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, your body becomes immaterial, and your spirit attempts to possess a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or be possessed for 1 hour. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the possession on a success. A creature that succeeds its saving throw against your {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} is immune to your {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

When you possess a creature, you control it, but the target retains awareness. Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the creature, though you retain your alignment and your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You retain your own class features and feats, and can cast spells. If the target has any class levels, you can't use any of its class features.

When the {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} ends, you are ejected from the body and rematerialize within 5 feet of the target. The {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} ends early if the creature drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or you choose to end it as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action.
Once you use this Grand Hex, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 6+ spell slot (no action required).

name: Precision Explosives
entries: Your Bombs are extremely precise. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Bombs
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to your Alchemist save DC. This bonus increases to +2 when you reach Alchemist level 11.

entries.name: Sculpt Explosion
entries: When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, you can choose a number of creatures within the explosion up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). Each chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throws against the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} and takes no damage from it.

name: Prismatic Bomb
entries: By adding an ounce of polyjuice, an unpredictable, multicolored chemical, to your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents, you can change it into a Prismatic Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals a randomly-determined damage type instead of Fire damage, and the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property requires a randomly-determined type of saving throw. Roll on each of the Prismatic Bomb tables.

name: Prismatic Cantrip
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you deal Force damage with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=force}, you can roll a {@dice d6} on the Prismatic Cantrip table to change the cantrip's damage type for this casting. You can apply tricks to the casting as normal using the new damage type. Additionally, you can apply the trick corresponding to the rolled damage type, even if you don't know the trick.
You can use this trick a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Puncture

prerequisite.other: {@filter Piercing Damage [Craftsman Only]|items|source=|type=melee weapon;ranged weapon|weapon damage type=p}

entries: If you hit a creature with an attack roll with this weapon and the roll is an 18–20 on the d20, you score a Critical Hit.

name: Push
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

name: Quiet Bomb
entries: By replacing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a pouch of rubber pellets, you can change it into a Quiet Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Bludgeoning damage instead of Fire damage. When this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} detonates, it makes only a low thud, audible out to 10 feet, and releases a puff of smoke to mask the light of the blast. Additionally, when you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24}, you can instead knock it out.

The creature is instead reduced to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. The creature remains {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} until it regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or until someone uses an action to administer first aid to it, which requires a successful DC 10 Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check.

name: Radiant Cantrip
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you cast a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=acid;cold;fire;force;lightning;poison;thunder} that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage, you can change the damage type to Radiant.

When you deal Radiant damage with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (VSS'24)}, you can reroll one of the cantrip's damage dice, and you must use the new roll. The number of damage dice you can reroll increases by 1 when you reach Warmage levels 11 (2 dice) and 17 (3 dice).

name: Rake

prerequisite.other: {@filter Slashing Damage [Craftsman Only]|items|source=|type=melee weapon;ranged weapon|weapon damage type=s}

entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature takes an extra 1d6 damage the next time you hit it using a weapon before the end of your next turn. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon.

name: Rally
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn, you can expend one Battle Die to choose one ally within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you. That creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number rolled plus your Charisma modifier. You can't use this maneuver to heal a creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Rampage
entries: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you reduce an enemy to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} with a melee attack roll, you can expend one Battle Die to move up to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and make a melee attack (no action required). On a hit, you add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll.

name: Rapid Fortification
entries: You can cast the {@spell Mending|XPHB} cantrip as an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. If you cast it as an action, you can use one of the following effects.

entries.name: Repair
entries: You can restore a single nonmagical object, such as a door, {@item Cart|XPHB}, or window, to pristine condition if at least half of its parts are present. This object can be no larger than 10 cubic feet, or 1 cubic foot if it is exceptionally complex (such as a clock).

entries.name: Fortify
entries: You can build simple fortifications, such as sealing a door shut, adding wooden planks to a window, or building a short stone wall (no larger than 10 cubic feet). You must have the materials present to use this ability.

name: Riposte
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend three Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to enter a defensive stance against it. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. Once before the start of your next turn, when the target makes an attack against you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one attack with a weapon against the attacker. Resolve your attack before the triggering attack. On a hit, its attack automatically misses you.

name: Ruinous Blow
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend two Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to sunder its defenses. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. The target has a -3 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn.

name: Sap

prerequisite.other: {@itemProperty Versatile|XPHB} Property or No Weapon Property

entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Scatter
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your ranged attack rolls with this weapon. This weapon's range is 20/60 if it were higher.

name: Seeking Bomb
entries: By replacing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a powerful lodestone, you can change it into a Seeking Bomb. Your ranged attack with this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} and its explosion ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} and {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}.

name: Self-Taught
entries: You taught yourself all the fundamentals of magic from a dusty old tome or abandoned scroll. You learn the {@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB} and {@spell Light|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

name: Severe Cantrip
entries: When a creature rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} for a saving throw against one of your Warmage cantrips, it suffers a Critical Failure. It fails the save regardless of its modifiers or the spell save DC. If the spell deals damage, you roll all of the spell's damage dice twice and add them together, then add any relevant modifiers. This additional damage applies only to the creature that rolled a 1.

name: Shift

prerequisite.other: {@filter Melee Weapon, Light or Finesse Property|items|source=|type=melee weapon|property=light;finesse}

entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can immediately move 10 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

name: Sighted
entries: Attacking at long range with this weapon doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls. When you hit a creature with an attack using this weapon at long range, you can reroll any of the damage dice and must use the new roll.

name: Silent Cantrip
entries: Once on each of your turns immediately after you deal Thunder damage to an enemy with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=thunder}, you can create a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of magical silence originating from the target, which lasts until the start of your next turn. Any creature or object entirely inside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Thunder damage, and creatures have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.

name: Skirmish
entries: When you make an attack using a weapon, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make an attack using a weapon later on the same turn. One attack must be a melee attack roll and the other must be a ranged attack roll.

name: Slow
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

name: Smoke Bomb
entries: By removing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents entirely, you can change it into a Smoke Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals no damage, but creates a {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of smoke that is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. The radius of this {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is twice that of the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind (such as one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses it.

name: Snake Eyes
entries: If you roll a 1 or 2 on a Die of Fate, you keep the die instead of giving it to the GM.

name: Spellstrike
entries: Whenever you cast {@spell Arc Blade|ValdaSpire24}, {@spell Burning Blade|ValdaSpire24}, {@spell Frigid Blade|ValdaSpire24}, or {@spell True Strike|XPHB}, you can make two attacks as a part of the spell instead of one. You can only apply the cantrip's bonus damage to one of the attacks.

name: Split Fire
entries: When you cast a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (VSS'24)} that requires a single spell attack roll, you can select multiple creatures and make a spell attack roll against each one. You can target a number of creatures equal to the number of damage dice the cantrip deals, and split your damage dice up amongst your targets, to a minimum of 1 die of damage per target. Each attack must target a different creature. For example, {@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB} deals {@damage 3d10} damage at level 5. You can choose to target three creatures and deal {@damage 1d10} damage to each creature, or you can target two creatures, dealing {@damage 1d10} damage to one creature and {@damage 2d10} damage to the other creature, or you can target one creature and deal {@damage 3d10} damage.

name: Staggering Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to daze the target.
