Add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll. The target subtracts the Battle Die from the next attack roll it makes before the end of your next turn.

name: Stalemate
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend one Battle Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to hold that creature in place. Add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

name: Starving
entries: No matter how much you eat, food turns to ash in your mouth. Your curse nourishes you at the edge of starvation, and you are constantly wracked by pangs of hunger. Forgoing food and drink doesn't give you levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

name: Static Cantrip
entries: Whenever you deal Lightning damage to an enemy with a {@filter Warmage cantrip|spells|level=0|class=warmage (vss'24)|damage type=lightning}, you can sap part of the energy into a charge, which clings to your body until the start of your next turn. While charged, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} in response to taking damage from a creature you can see within 5 feet of you to deal Lightning damage equal to half your Warmage level to the creature.

name: Stunning Blow
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend three Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to stun the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the condition on itself on a success.

name: Survivalist
entries: To survive in the wild, you taught yourself to cast simple spells. You learn the {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} and {@spell Shillelagh|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival|XPHB} skill.

name: Teleportation Bomb
entries: By replacing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a glowing etherite crystal, you can change it into a Teleportation Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals no damage. Instead, you teleport to the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} point of impact. This teleportation fails if the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} explodes more than 30 feet away from you.

name: Temple Initiate
entries: A monastery or temple educated you in the ways of gentle healing magic. You learn the {@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB} and {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Religion|XPHB} skill.

name: Tension
entries: When making a Ranged attack with this weapon, you use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

name: Topple
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Tower Apprentice
entries: You apprenticed under a spellcaster for some time, who taught you the fundamentals of arcana. You learn the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} and {@spell Shocking Grasp|XPHB} cantrips and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} skill.

name: Twinshot
entries: If you hit a creature with a ranged attack roll using this weapon, you can make a ranged attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 10 feet of the first that is also within the weapon's range. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Unconventional Explosives
entries: You've discovered new ways to utilize your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bombs}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Explosive Missile
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action with a {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to load the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} onto a crossbow and launch it. The {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} uses the crossbow's range, but you can't use its {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property for this attack. You can apply a formula and prime this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} as normal.

entries.name: Fire Eater
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to drink the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} contents and spit them out in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. This {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} acts as the area of the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property. You can apply a formula and prime this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} as normal, extending the area of the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} by 5 feet for each {@classFeature Reagents|Alchemist|ValdaSpire24|1||Reagent} when you prime the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24}.

name: Unconventional Potions
entries: Your research has chiefly revealed how to deliver potions quickly. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Potion Toss
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to hurl a potion at an ally within 30 feet of yourself. The target gains the potion's benefits as if it had consumed the potion normally.

entries.name: Reactionary Gulp
entries: Immediately after you take damage from a creature you can see, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to drink a potion. You can use this ability to drink a potion that restores your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, even if the triggering damage reduces you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Vex
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Visions
entries: You are cursed to have grimly accurate visions of the future, presaging the death of your friends, your family, and yourself. You gain a bonus to {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

name: Whirlwind
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend three Battle Dice to make up to three extra melee or ranged attacks using a weapon. Each attack must be against a different target within the weapon's range that you haven't attacked this turn. On a hit with one of these extra attacks, add a Battle Die to the damage roll.

name: Whispers
entries: Unseen voices murmur in your ears at all times. You have {@variantrule Telepathy|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

name: Witch's Broom
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to enchant a mundane object—such as a broom, cauldron, or rug—with the power of flight. While holding this item, you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet. This object remains enchanted until you use this Grand Hex to enchant a different object.

name: Witch's Hut
entries: You can perform a ritual over the course of 8 hours, which can be done during a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, to enchant a structure that fits within a 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}, animating it as a Huge object, as per the {@spell Animate Objects|XPHB} spell. The structure walks using a pair of magical legs.

The entrance to the structure is linked to an extradimensional dwelling, as per the {@spell Demiplane|XPHB} spell. You can command the structure from inside this dwelling. If the structure is destroyed, the extradimensional dwelling is unharmed, but any creatures inside it are expelled into the unoccupied spaces nearest to the entrance.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can teleport the structure to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you. Once you teleport the structure, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
You can repeat the ritual to end the enchantment on your previous structure and enchant a new one.

name: Withering Bomb
entries: By mixing your {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} explosive contents with a powerful desiccating agent, you can change it into a Withering Bomb. This {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} deals Necrotic damage instead of Fire damage and all of its damage dice are d8s. When you use the {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24|Bomb's} {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, each creature within the explosion makes a Constitution saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A target hit by this {@item Bomb|ValdaSpire24} or that fails its saving throw against it has a -3 penalty on saving throws it makes before the start of your next turn.

name: Wounding Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend two Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to deal the target a bleeding wound. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. A creature with a bleeding wound can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and takes Necrotic damage equal to a roll of your Battle Die for each of its wounds at the start of each of its turns. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}. A creature can take an action to staunch all of its bleeding wounds.
